optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Hotspots
## Rules
- `specd graph hotspots [--workspace <name>] [--kind <kinds>] [--file <path>] [--exclude-path <pattern>] [--exclude-workspace <name>] [--limit <n>] [--min-score <n>] [--include-importer-only] [--min-risk LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL] [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`; `--config` / `--path` exclusive.
- Defaults: `kinds = class,method,function`, exclude importer-only, `minScore > 0`, `minRisk >= MEDIUM`, `limit = 20`. Explicit option changes only own default; scope/exclude filters add restrictions; `--include-importer-only` widens.
- Context: `--config` direct; `--path` ignores discovery → VCS-root synthetic `default` workspace; no flags → autodiscover then VCS bootstrap fallback.
- `--kind`: one comma list; trim/validate `SymbolKind`; invalid fails before query; multi-kind passed through; explicit list replaces default; omitted excludes `variable` / `interface`.
- Resolve `cli:graph-cli-context`; `withProvider`; `provider.getHotspots(...)`; platform symbols `@specd/sdk`; pass all filters.
- No pre-open lock probe. `GRAPH_BUSY`, `GRAPH_PROVIDER_STALE`, provider/open/retrieval infrastructure failure exit 3; option conflict exit 1.
- Text ranked table: totals, score, risk, cross-workspace callers, kind, name, workspace-qualified path; empty `No hotspots found.` JSON/TOON: `totalSymbols`, `entries` with symbol, `score`, `directCallers`, `crossWorkspaceCallers`, `fileImporters`, `riskLevel`, `workspace`.
- Help + `docs/cli/cli-reference.md`: signature, comma-list `--kind`, defaults/replacement, importer-only switch, config/path and bootstrap-only behavior.
## Constraints
- Provider computes score; shared `SymbolKind` validation; CLI never implements pre-open availability checks.
